disaster.jaymoskingdoms.forecast.tsunami: The sea drawing back and coming in, %s, within %s hours.
disaster.jaymoskingdoms.forecast.hurrica: A great storm off the sea, %s, within %s hours.
disaster.jaymoskingdoms.forecast.avalanc: The snow letting go on the heights, %s, within %s hours.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.relief.food.volcano: The ash killed the crops where they stood and the fire took the rest. Could you bring %1$s %2$s? We'll pay what we can.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.relief.food.tsunami: The sea took the boats, the nets and the stores with them. Could you bring %1$s %2$s? We'll pay what we can.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.relief.food.hurrica: The storm flattened the fields and drowned the cellars. Could you bring %1$s %2$s? We'll pay what we can.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.relief.food.avalanc: The snow came down on the stores and we can't dig to them. Could you bring %1$s %2$s? We'll pay what we can.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.relief.food.landsli: The hillside buried the granary. Could you bring %1$s %2$s? We'll pay what we can.
The fire it lit ran through the fields before we could stop it. Could you bring %1$s %2$s? We'll pay what we can.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.relief.rubble.volca: Clearing up after the burning mountain
Stones fell out of the sky and the ash lies over everything. Clear %1$s blocks of it round %2$s, would you?
quest.jaymoskingdoms.relief.rubble.tsuna: The wave left wreckage and sand in every street. Clear %1$s blocks of it round %2$s so we can find what's left.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.relief.rubble.hurri: Roofs, walls, half a barn: the wind dropped them everywhere. Clear %1$s blocks of it round %2$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.relief.rubble.avala: The snow and stone buried the lower houses. Dig %1$s blocks of it away round %2$s, before anyone freezes.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.relief.rubble.lands: Half the hill came down on us. Dig %1$s blocks of earth and stone away round %2$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.relief.rubble.meteo: Clearing up after the falling star
Earth and burning stone came down all round when it struck. Clear %1$s blocks of it round %2$s.
memory.jaymoskingdoms.sandstorm.0: %s days since the great sandstorm. We're still sweeping it out of the beds.
memory.jaymoskingdoms.sandstorm.1: The sand came over the walls like water, %s days ago. I'd never seen the sun go brown before.
memory.jaymoskingdoms.blizzard.0: %s days since the great blizzard. We burned the fences to stay alive.
memory.jaymoskingdoms.blizzard.1: My neighbour went out for the goats in the blizzard, %s days back. They found her in the thaw.
memory.jaymoskingdoms.hail.0: Hail the size of fists, %s days ago. Look at the roofs, you can still see where it came through.
memory.jaymoskingdoms.hail.1: The hail killed the whole crop in an hour, %s days back. An hour.
memory.jaymoskingdoms.wildfire.0: %s days since the fire came through. The smell's still in the timbers.
memory.jaymoskingdoms.wildfire.1: We stood in the river and watched it all burn, %s days ago. You don't forget that.
memory.jaymoskingdoms.flood.0: The water came up to the second step, %s days ago. Higher than any flood my father told of.
memory.jaymoskingdoms.flood.1: %s days since the great flood. Every cellar in the place still stinks of it.
memory.jaymoskingdoms.quake.0: %s days since the ground broke open. I still wake at night thinking it's moving.
memory.jaymoskingdoms.quake.1: The great quake brought the tower down, %s days ago. They're still digging the stones out.
memory.jaymoskingdoms.volcano.0: %s days since the mountain burned. The ash still turns up in the bread.
memory.jaymoskingdoms.volcano.1: Stones out of the sky, and fire running down the hill, %s days ago. The priest said it was the end.
memory.jaymoskingdoms.tsunami.0: The sea drew back like a breath, %s days ago, and then it came in. We lost the whole harbour.
memory.jaymoskingdoms.tsunami.1: %s days since the great wave. We're still finding boats in the fields.
memory.jaymoskingdoms.hurricane.0: %s days since the great storm off the sea. The wind took the church roof clean off.
memory.jaymoskingdoms.hurricane.1: There was a still bit in the middle of the storm, %s days ago. Then it came back the other way.
memory.jaymoskingdoms.avalanche.0: %s days since the snow came down off the heights. It buried the lower farms whole.
memory.jaymoskingdoms.avalanche.1: A sound like thunder, %s days ago, and then the whole slope was moving.
memory.jaymoskingdoms.landslide.0: %s days since the hill came down. The road's still under it.
memory.jaymoskingdoms.landslide.1: The rain loosened the hillside, %s days ago, and half of it ended up in the mill.
memory.jaymoskingdoms.meteor.0: A star fell, %s days ago. You can stand on the edge of the hole it made and not see the bottom.
memory.jaymoskingdoms.meteor.1: %s days since the star came down. The sky was grey for a day after, and the cattle wouldn't eat.
